summary: Correct updater polling, template destinations and Python expression scope

Fixed: Keep the host updater and heartbeat running across transient queue-lock contention without suppressing recovery errors.
Resolve relative ADC template destinations from the caller's PowerShell location rather than the process startup directory.
Attribute eager function parameter and return annotation calls to their defining scope while respecting postponed annotations.
Keep comprehension-local names from resolving to outside imports or creating false argument dependencies, without hiding legitimate enclosing calls.
Changed: Advance parse evidence to format 4 so the next normal repository indexing job reparses older annotation and comprehension evidence atomically.
